fontsize-2xs.$description: Below the Material scale — inherited. Fixed across breakpoints.

fontsize-sm.$description: Material body-small / label-medium (12). Fixed — body text never shrinks.

fontsize-xl.$description: Compact keeps 20; Medium = title-large (22); Expanded = headline-small (24).

fontsize-jumbo.$description: display-medium (45) → display-large (57) → 64, above the Material maximum.

lineheight-2xs.$description: Paired with fontSize/2xs on Material’s size-to-line-height ratios.

lineheight-xs.$description: Paired with fontSize/xs on Material’s size-to-line-height ratios.

lineheight-sm.$description: Paired with fontSize/sm on Material’s size-to-line-height ratios.

lineheight-md.$description: Paired with fontSize/md on Material’s size-to-line-height ratios.

lineheight-lg.$description: Paired with fontSize/lg on Material’s size-to-line-height ratios.

lineheight-xl.$description: Paired with fontSize/xl on Material’s size-to-line-height ratios.

lineheight-3xl.$description: Paired with fontSize/3xl on Material’s size-to-line-height ratios.
